_comment: USD per million tokens. Editable; dashboard.py re-reads this file when it changes. Keys starting with _ are ignored. cache_write is the 5-minute TTL rate, because the single-rate formula in SPEC 6.5 has no separate 1-hour price. claude-haiku-5-5 uses its rate for prompts up to 100K tokens; its cache rates are derived from the standard 0.1x and 1.25x multipliers. Rates cached 2026-10-06, so check them against the Anthropic pricing page. A model missing from this table shows a dash in the UI.
